summary: Iteration 42 — QRU Factory™ Product Continuity Principle™ engine (Constitution QRU-CON-0001 §4/§14G) validated end-to-end, backend + frontend. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration42_continuity.py (~1.6s parallel). POST /api/factory-os/projects {video, 'forex trading basics'} → id (no _id leak), mode='auto_continue', 11-stage chain, KR stage 'complete' (KR auto-matched via KR-00048/KR-00075), auto-advanced to 'Video Script & Narration' status 'in_progress', summary carries current_stage/current_stage_status/remaining_stages(10)/recommended_next_action/percent. Obscure topic {video, 'quantum basket weaving on mars'} → KR stage 'blocked' with route '/promotion-pipeline', subsequent stages 'pending'. Lifecycle: 3× POST /projects/{id}/complete-stage walks the 3 workflow stages (video_script → scene_matching → assembly → founder_approval), engine auto-completes 'thumbnail_metadata' + 'quality_review' (auto) and STOPS at 'Founder Approval' gate (status 'needs_approval', recommendation asks for approval). POST /approve → founder_approval='complete', gold_master='needs_approval'. POST /approve again → gold_master='complete', vault='complete', publishing='blocked' with route '/distribution' and recommendation asking to Set up a destination. HONESTY guarantee verified: 3 further complete-stage calls DO NOT flip publishing/distribution to 'complete' — they remain blocked/pending. Pause/Resume/Stop: mode='paused' sets recommended_next_action to 'Paused by the operator. Resume to continue.'; 'auto_continue' resumes and re-advances; 'stopped' persists; invalid mode 'yolo' → HTTP 400. GET /api/factory-os/projects returns {projects:[…]} with per-project summary and no _id leak; GET /projects/{bad_id} → 404. Regression: /outcomes returns 11 outcomes with operating_question; /plan {video, forex} returns ok=true, can_launch=true, launch.route='/flagship-showcase'. Frontend Playwright (1920×1080, Founder login): nav-projects visible in Start Here → /projects renders projects-page. /create video → topic 'forex trading basics' → create-build-plan → create-launch → POSTs /factory-os/projects and navigates to /flagship-showcase. Back at /projects, new project card project-{id} renders with 11-chip pipeline (project-stages-{id}), progress bar, and Next line (project-next-{id}). Pause (project-pause-{id}) → next line becomes 'Paused by the operator. Resume to continue.'; Resume (project-resume-{id}) re-advances. Clicking Mark stage done (project-complete-{id}) 3× advances through the workflow stages, auto stages complete silently, and Approve & continue (project-approve-{id}) appears with next='Your approval is required at “Founder Approval”…'. Approve → gold_master approval button appears. Approve → Publishing 'blocked' state: Set up destination (project-setup-{id}) appears and next reads exactly '“Publishing” needs a connector. Set up a destination in the Distribution Center™.' Never faked as published (screenshot confirmed 9/11 stages, Publishing chip in rose 'blocked' color, Platform Distribution still pending).

minor.issue: When KR stage is blocked, continuity.py hard-sets route='/promotion-pipeline' but _ROUTE_LABEL only maps /flagship-showcase, /manufacture, /distribution → falls back to 'Distribution Center™'. Result: recommended_next_action reads '“Knowledge Record” needs a connector. Set up a destination in the Distribution Center™.' — that's misleading since a blocked KR is NOT a connector issue and the correct destination is the Promotion Pipeline™ (Knowledge Manufacturing). Suggestion: add '/promotion-pipeline':'Promotion Pipeline™' to _ROUTE_LABEL and, when the blocked stage kind=='auto' (KR), phrase the message as 'Manufacture the Knowledge Record first in the Promotion Pipeline™.'

ui_bugs.issue: Button label 'Set up destination' displays for a blocked Knowledge Record whose route is '/promotion-pipeline' — clicking navigates to Promotion Pipeline, not a distribution destination. Label should switch based on stage.kind (e.g., 'Manufacture the Knowledge Record' for blocked auto stages).

action_items: OPTIONAL: In continuity.py add '/promotion-pipeline':'Promotion Pipeline™' to _ROUTE_LABEL and special-case _recommended() when a blocked stage.kind=='auto' so the message correctly says 'Manufacture the Knowledge Record first' rather than 'Set up a destination'.
OPTIONAL: In ProjectsContinuity.js change the 'blocked' CTA label to depend on cur.kind — 'Set up destination' for connector, 'Manufacture the Knowledge Record' for a blocked auto (KR) stage.
critical_code_review_comments: continuity.py _advance_auto() sets s['status']='pending_connector' then immediately overrides to 'blocked' on the very next line — dead code path; drop the intermediate assignment for clarity.

continuity.py _connector_ready() is defined and awaits db.distribution_jobs.count_documents but is never called — it always returns True/msg but no caller. Either wire it into _advance_auto (make connector 'ready' when a destination is configured — that would fulfil the auto-publish promise) or remove the function so the honest 'always-blocked' path stays intentional.
continuity.py list_projects(actor) accepts an actor arg but ignores it (uses q={}) — every user sees every project. If multi-tenancy or per-user filtering is intended, filter by created_by.

continuity.py CHAINS['video'] hard-codes 11 stages — the KR stage is 'auto', so a project created without a verified KR sets it to 'blocked' manually in create_project (not via _advance_auto). This dual state machine (create_project bypasses _advance_auto for the KR override) is fine but should be documented; an amendment to §14G could otherwise diverge silently.

routers/factory_os.py — /projects/{pid}/approve returns 200 with note='No approval is currently required.' when no gate is pending. Consider returning 409 Conflict for clarity so a UI can distinguish 'nothing to approve' from a successful approval.

ProjectsContinuity.js: `disabled={busy}` is truthy for every card whenever any action is in flight, disabling ALL approve/complete buttons across every project. For a Founder with many projects, block only the acting card: `disabled={busy===p.id+path}`.

ProjectsContinuity.js: `p.knowledge_record.kr_code` is dereferenced without a nullish check on kr_code — if the record has no code, this shows 'KR undefined'. Guard with `p.knowledge_record?.kr_code && …`.

CreateExperience.js launch() ignores API errors silently (catches then still navigates). This is intentional for UX resilience, but the toast.message() masks true failures. Consider surfacing e.response?.data?.detail in dev mode.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 pytest: create×2 [forex-auto-KR + obscure-blocked-KR], lifecycle×4 [3 workflow completes → founder gate, approve → gold_master gate, approve → publishing-blocked honesty, 3 repeated completes never flip publish], mode×4 [pause, resume, stop, invalid-400], list+get 404×2, regression×2 [/outcomes, /plan])
success_rate.frontend: 100% (Founder login → /projects renders; /create video 'forex trading basics' → launch POST /projects + nav /flagship-showcase; /projects shows new card with 11-chip pipeline, progress bar, pause/resume/stop + approve×2 + set-up-destination; Publishing chip rose 'blocked' — never green)
